description: This file defines an enum class 'CameraHudKind' representing different HUD states for camera operations, and a data class 'CameraHudState' encapsulating the state with properties like token, kind, and message.

classes.name: CameraHudKind
classes.description: An enumeration of possible HUD states related to camera activities such as Photo, Recording, Success, and Error.

classes.name: CameraHudState
classes.description: A data class representing the current HUD state, including a token, the kind of HUD (as CameraHudKind), and an associated message.
